posts.text:
Election integrity isn't a one-time achievement. It's the result of years of hard work, reform, and accountability. 

Tennessee's top ranking in Heritage's 2026 Election Integrity Scorecard and Florida's remarkable transformation from election turmoil to a national leader show that states can strengthen voter confidence when they're willing to do the work.
